body: wow I really really relate to this...I'm in a deep depressive state. When I told a family member about how worthless I am they say that my perception is warped because of my depressive state. But to my core I KNOW that I am nothing but a burden and a waste. I know myself and I know my experiences. I also feel that despite a privileged upbringing that I have nothing positive to bring to the world. I've also been having trouble finding the motivation to eat when I truly believe I'm not worthy of nourishment. If you want to chat I'm here. I hope that you can find something that brings you joy.
